name: Fort Barracks
player_description: Long timber buildings arranged in rows. Eight men to a room -- contubernium quarters. The smell of leather oil, sweat, and bread. Soldiers sleep, argue, gamble, and clean their equipment. This is where most of the fort lives.
gm_notes: DC 12 Perception (passive): someone has been in a different contubernium's room. DC 13 Investigation: a loose board under one bunk hides a sealed letter with no addressee. DC 15 Arcana: the wax seal has a faint magical imprint -- it has been read and resealed once.
